text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King phones Palestinian leader Arafat and congratulates him on reaching Hebron accord with Israeli government.
- U.S. President Clinton tells King Hussein he looks forward to meeting him "to coordinate positions".
- Jordanian-Iraqi economic talks continue in Baghdad. Jordanian energy minister expects to conclude an oil accord with Iraq soon which will meet most of Jordan's 1997 energy needs.
- Jordan reaffirms its support for Sudan.
- King receives phone call from Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu on Hebron.
- International praise for the efforts of King Hussein in "saving the peace process".
- Heavy rains in last 24 hours help pastures and promise a good agricultural season, but have limited effect on reservoirs.
